children: WINNIPEG — Canola futures retreated on Wednesday after rallying over the previous three sessions, following weakness from vegetable oils.

Chicago soyoil, European rapeseed and Malaysian palm oil were in the red. Meanwhile, crude oil made modest gains after recent attacks on the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Tropical Storm Isaias is expected to turn into a hurricane when it makes landfall along the United States Gulf Coast on Friday.
Daytime high temperatures across the Prairies are expected to be in the teens. Despite cooler temperatures than on Tuesday, conditions will be sunny and dry.
The Canadian dollar was up more than one-tenth of a U.S. cent compared to Monday's close.
